questions.a: This is a GRAFT from a sibling project, not a greenfield framework selection. The graft ticket and proof are owed (Law 8).
The shape (route -> fetch device DATA -> render) is already proven in the current web_server. What changes is the transport and the ability to push updates.
ONE web server — the rule holds. This replaces the current one, it does not add a second.
The listener (the socket binding) stays thin — Starlette's ASGI is the new listener, uvicorn is the runner. The device logic (routing, rendering) stays in server.py and render.py.

workflow_and_state: code-seam@v2: THINKME -> TICKETME -> BUILDME -> PROVEME -> WATCHME(web-server-serves-dynamic-panes) -> [PROVED]

watchme.trigger: a pane is requested via HTTP and the server renders it dynamically
watchme.enough: three dynamic pane renders under real traffic, each returning correct content for the requesting device's current state
watchme.carrier: the request/response pair including the pane content and the device state it was rendered from
watchme.consumer: Akien — dynamic panes are the web server's reason for existing beyond static file serving
